what: C5 hands round 2 (hands/character): closed-loop pose calibration, relaxed finger curl with pads on the frame/table, torso untwist and body nearer the table, steepled patient hands before the mouth, breathing idle for the opponents, dense cloth player sleeve, hand-decal Rotator fix, watch 4 cm from the wrist
base: upstream 6ef6c53 (= f086766 scene, C4.1). Before = C5b_* on the upstream level; after = C5c_* (final build); C5a_* = previous after-build (same hand pose; steeple 4 cm higher, watch 2.5 cm from the wrist). Build PC 2026-10-14 23:09-23:24 and 2026-10-15 06:10-06:38 PC time, capture.ps1 -Preset epic 1920x1080 -WarmSec 22 -Probe Player
metric: C3/C4 recipe: 1045x588 PIL bicubic, Rec.709 luma, mean |Laplacian| (detail), median3 (after a 3x3 median), below8 = % luma < 8. Same script gives 9.65 on C41d_main (C4.1 json 9.66)

calibration.finding: the game scales every keyed bone translation to the MetaHuman mesh's proportions (evaluated/keyed 1.03-1.32 per bone, same direction); the solver modelled the skeleton's reference lengths, so the runtime hands were 6-9 cm further forward and the body 15-18 cm higher than predicted (C1 fingertips in the frame, PLAYER_Z_FIX 15.3)
calibration.check: editor evaluation of the authored sequence on the mesh (AnimPoseEvaluationOptions.optional_skeletal_mesh) vs the runtime -TCProbe: <= 0.11 cm on all 13 probed bones (s1 build)
calibration.loop: pass 0 keys the reference translations and evaluates; the model takes the evaluated lengths + pelvis offset (7.57 cm z); pass 1 residual model vs evaluated 0.0 cm on pelvis, head, elbows, wrists and every probed finger joint (player, probe and clasp poses); PLAYER_Z_FIX no longer applied (fallback 15.3 if the evaluation fails)
calibration.probe_vs_build: runtime _03 joints equal the build's predicted joints to 0.1 cm (e.g. index_03_l (-28.8, -19.1, 82.5) in both)

fingertips.rule: table top z 79.95, frame top +1.92 (|x| or |y| 23.2..27.65), squares +1.71; finger centre line to skin: 0.65 cm at the pad, 0.8 cm elsewhere. A pad centre line 0.5-0.8 cm over the surface = skin touching (0-0.15 cm)
fingertips.C1_before: index/middle _03 joints 1.8-2.4 cm below the frame top (in the frame); fingers hyperextended (solver at its -30 deg bound)
fingertips.nearest_piece: left middle tip x -24.1, 1.4 cm from the a1 rook's base (x -22.7); no finger over a square

pose.player_rest: wrists (-42, +-27) 3.4 cm over the table, yaw 22 inward, knuckles 4.4 cm, thumb side up 10 deg; spine_01 turned -10 deg (right shoulder was 10 cm back); eye 3 cm before the hidden head bone (was 9: chest 59 cm from the table edge); wrists 0.5 / 1.0 cm off target (C1: 6.5 / 16.4)
pose.fingers: absolute flexion near MCP 12-18 / PIP 38-46 deg (index to pinky), DIP 0.7 x added PIP, splay closed 35 % towards the middle finger
pose.patient: wrists 19 cm under / 20 cm before the head bone (0.6 / 1.9 cm off), palms facing, fingertips meeting at the midline: min finger-joint distance from the midline 1.02 cm (centre line; > 0.8 finger radius: no overlap), approx. cage clearance 3.4 cm
pose.breathing: opponents (clasp pose) loop 150 frames / 5 s: spine_03 -0.7 / spine_05 -0.5 deg x sin, head counter-rotation + slow drift (turn <= 1.3 deg); turns propagate rigidly (hands keep their spacing, move <= 0.7 cm); player has none (hands must not slide); TC_IDLE_AMP=0 restores the statue

static_same_position.why: -TCPlay=10 plays random engine moves, so before/after boards differ (C5a vs C5c, same pose: Black detail 9.31 vs 9.24); static captures (no plies, HUD on) compare the same position
static_same_position.reading: V2 detail -0.04 in both seats (capture noise is up to 0.04: C41d vs C5b, same scene), median3 unchanged; the steepled hands cover part of the cage grid (-0.9 in that cell), the curled hands at the bottom corners add (+0.6 / +1.1)

V1: final benchmark views inside all four bounds in both seats; tightest: main g/b 1.696 (limit 1.70, was 1.689), Black r/g 1.497 (limit 1.50, was 1.491). Thin margins: the hands and arms are now larger in frame
V2: not lowered beyond noise on the same position (static -0.04, median3 +-0.01); benchmark views -0.07 / -0.20 include different board positions
